description: Ministry of Sports & Youth Affairs - Amendment to the Gaz.Ex.No. 2166/09 that Published Notional Association of Sports Regulations
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Sports under the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973, specifically amending timeframes for financial statement submissions and election committee activities. The content focuses on legal/regulatory amendments to existing sports regulations, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements.
